rules: Paper only: Black-Scholes prices from India VIX, nothing is sent to any broker.
Algorithm B trades the account: every day it ranks the 19 indicators on all past days and keeps the best 5; a trade needs 4 of the 5 to agree. Donchian breakout keeps a shadow book for comparison.
Decisions at 10:15, 11:15, 12:15, 13:15, 14:15; at most one trade a day per book, NIFTY or SENSEX.
One lot (NIFTY 65, SENSEX 20), nearest weekly expiry with a day left; the strike nearest the money whose loss at the stop fits Rs 1,500.
Exit at premium -20 %, +40 % or 15:15, whichever first; stop checked first; Zerodha charges and Rs 0.50 a unit slippage each side.
